messages:
Mateo Cruz: Quick sync — VaultX wants to bundle SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and HSM-backed KMS auth in marketplace listing. Need rollout ops and joint announcement plan.
Priya Sharma: timeline? marketing wants 2 weeks lead for co-marketing assets.
Alice Nguyen: Technical preflight: does their HSM support PKCS#11 and our KMS gateway? @Igor can confirm.
Igor Petrov: They support PKCS#11 + CloudHSM shim. Need to validate attestation flow and key wrapping. I'll run an integration test by EOD.
VaultX-BizDev: We can provide test certs and an engineer for the POC next Tue. Also fine with a short co-demo.
Mateo Cruz: Ops questions — marketplace listing needs an architecture diagram, security appendix, and support routing. Who owns the diagram?
Alice Nguyen: I'll draft the diagram. Can someone list the security requirements we need to call out (audits, SOC2, KMS rotation, SCIM sync interval)?
Priya Sharma: Callouts: SOC2, data residency (EU region), SCIM delta + bulk, SSO SAML metadata URL, IDP-initiated + SP-initiated support, SSO troubleshooting playbook.
Igor Petrov: Add: HSM-backed key import policy, key rotation window, attestation docs, TLS mutual auth on KMS gateway.
VaultX-BizDev: On KMS rotation — we support 30/90 day rotation windows. We can also support customer-managed keys via BYOK.
Mateo Cruz: Good. Action items: 1) Alice to produce arch diagram + security appendix (due 3d). 2) Igor to run PKCS#11 integration test and post logs (due EOD). 3) VaultX to provide test certs and engineer for POC (next Tue). 4) Priya to draft co-announcement timeline and ask marketing for assets (due 2w).
Alice Nguyen: Ack — will post initial diagram here in a PR link.
Igor Petrov: Test started: failing on wrapping policy with 1.2. Will troubleshoot; posting sample command below:
```
# test key wrap
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so -l --sign --id 01 --mechanism RSA-PKCS
```
Priya Sharma: Also flagging legal: need to confirm joint messaging re: compliance claims. @legal-team please advise.
VaultX-BizDev: Noted — I'll introduce you to our legal PM.
integrations-bot: New POC workspace created: https://redwood.workspaces/pocteam/vaultx-1843
Mateo Cruz: Great. Let's reconvene Fri 09:30 PT to review diagram & test results. :calendar: 
Alice Nguyen: Sounds good. I'll aim to have first pass by Thu night.
Priya Sharma: I'll prepare a one-page partner brief for marketing review.
Mateo Cruz: Thanks all — I'll send a follow-up with the calendar invite and updated action-item list.
